answer: In this PoA network, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while temporal decay halves reputation at a fixed interval. Honest influence therefore requires sustained, corroborated service: a freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality, and colluding identities cannot amplify one another without trusted paths. Consensus rejects their claims; mirror, atlas, and lagoon are merely labels, not earned trust.
